t: Introduction and overview — Type 26 City-class Frigate
name: Introduction and overview — Type 26 City-class Frigate — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Type 26 City-class Frigate
description: Introduction and overview of the Type 26 City-class Frigate: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Royal Navy's Type 26 City class — eight planned — is the next-generation anti-submarine frigate: 8,000 tons with 48 Sea Ceptor missiles, 24 Mk 41 cells, and a mission bay. Australia (Hunter class) and Canada (River class) adopted the design, making it a three-navy program. Baseline facts: Royal Navy next-gen ASW frigate; 8 planned; 8,000 tons; adopted by Australia/Canada..

description: Comparison with contemporaries of the Type 26 City-class Frigate: How the class compared with rival navies' ships. The Royal Navy's Type 26 City class — eight planned — is the next-generation anti-submarine frigate: 8,000 tons with 48 Sea Ceptor missiles, 24 Mk 41 cells, and a mission bay. Australia (Hunter class) and Canada (River class) adopted the design, making it a three-navy program. Baseline facts: Royal Navy next-gen ASW frigate; 8 planned; 8,000 tons; adopted by Australia/Canada..
